title: The case of the disputed $100 order
subtitle: One online sale, followed from checkout to a chargeback and back. An unofficial teaching comic built from public sources.
style: clean flat cartoon, thick dark outlines, soft pastel backgrounds, friendly faces, no logos or brand names

maya.name: Maya
maya.role: runs a small online tea shop
maya.look: woman in her 30s, black hair in a bun, green shirt with a white apron

leo.name: Leo
leo.look: man in his 20s, short brown hair, purple hoodie and a matching cap

priya.name: Priya
priya.role: dispute analyst at the merchant's acquirer
priya.look: woman in her 40s, long dark-brown hair, blue blazer, phone headset

panels.scene: Leo on his couch buying a tin of tea on his phone
panels.caption: Day 0, 8 pm. Leo orders $100 of tea online.
panels.lesson: Checkout: the shopper's card or wallet details go to the merchant's gateway.

panels.scene: Priya at her desk explaining how the authorization travels
panels.caption: One second later.

bubbles.text: Our switch routes the auth by the card's BIN to the network, then to Leo's bank. It says yes and places a hold.

panels.lesson: Authorization asks the issuer to stand behind the amount. No money moves yet.

panels.scene: Maya packing a box in her shop at the end of the day
panels.caption: Day 0, evening.

bubbles.text: Shipped! I'll capture it and the batch closes tonight.

panels.lesson: Capture and batch close turn the auth into a deposit the acquirer settles through the networks.

panels.scene: Maya smiling at a laptop showing her bank deposit
panels.caption: Day 1.

bubbles.text: The net deposit landed by ACH: sales minus fees.

panels.lesson: Funding: the acquirer pays the merchant the net amount on the agreed schedule.

panels.scene: Leo on the phone with his bank, worried
panels.caption: Five weeks later.

bubbles.text: I don't think my tea ever arrived. Can you dispute it?

panels.lesson: The cardholder disputes with the issuer, not with the merchant's acquirer.

panels.scene: Maya reading a chargeback notice, surprised
panels.caption: The issuer files a chargeback.
panels.lesson: A first chargeback debits the merchant through the acquirer right away.

panels.scene: Priya on a video call with Maya, pointing at a tracking record

bubbles.text: Send me the delivery tracking and the order record, before the deadline.
Signed for on day 3. Here it is.

panels.lesson: Representment: the merchant answers with evidence, sent through the acquirer by the network's deadline.

panels.scene: Maya relieved, Priya giving a thumbs up
panels.caption: The issuer accepts the evidence.

bubbles.text: The $100 is credited back. If they push further, it's pre-arbitration, then the network decides.

panels.lesson: If representment wins, the money comes back; otherwise the case can go to pre-arbitration and arbitration.

footer: Unofficial teaching comic. Fictional people and shop. Facts from the merchant-services-guide in this repo (public sources).
